title: Zesty Pillowy Malaysian Kinako Pancakes
description: These fluffy pancakes are a kid-friendly Malaysian dish featuring kinako, a roasted soybean flour, and a hint of zesty flavor, finished with a flambe touch.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together kinako, all-purpose flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, melted butter, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
In a small saucepan, heat the grand marnier over low heat.
Carefully flambe the grand marnier by igniting it with a match, then pour it over the pancakes.
Serve the pancakes immediately, garnished with additional kinako if desired.
